The <b>Architect's Key</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Opens the [[Chapel of the Architect]] in the [[Underworks]].<ref><i>"A locked gate bearing the symbol of an Architect."</i></ref>

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Architect Crest.png!Chapel of the Architect location in the Underworks
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Architect's Key 01.png!Chapel of the Architect gate in the Underworks
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Twelfth Architect]] for {{R|110}} after acquiring a total of 25 [[Tools]].<ref>[[Twelfth Architect]]: <i>"If Bug-Red could prove their aptitude with our implements, and others like, I would offer my key, to grant access to the chapel-store above."</i></ref>

|Image1 = Mapshot SS Twelfth Architect 01.png!Location of Twelfth Architect in the Underworks

}}
